title: Hedge fund recruits memory champion Nelson Dellis to remote view the stock market
summary: Chris Ramsay tells of Hedge fund recruits memory champion Nelson Dellis to remote view the stock market, about c. 2022-2023 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: United States (contacted via a memory Facebook group)

tellings.quote: To see if I if I'd be willing to be trained in remote viewing in order to remote view the stock market for them.

plain: Chris Ramsay, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a story from Nelson Dellis, a memory champion, set around 2022 or 2023. As told, a hedge fund, a firm that invests large sums of money, contacted Dellis through a Facebook group about memory and asked if he would train in remote viewing, the claimed ability to sense distant things with the mind alone, so he could use it to predict the stock market for them. If true, it would mean serious money is being bet on psychic abilities.
